channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: New York and New Jersey file suit over Gateway tunnel funding
item.description: New York and New Jersey filed suit against the Trump administration late Tuesday, demanding the full restoration of federal funds for construction of the Gateway Project's Hudson River Tunnel.

item.title: Meryl Streep to play Joni Mitchell in Cameron Crowe’s upcoming biopic
item.description: The 76-year-old actress is expected to play the influential singer-songwriter behind classic rock staples "Big Yellow Taxi," "Both Sides Now" and "River" in her later years.

item.title: NYPD bodycam video shows cop shoot mentally ill Queens man charging at him with knife
item.description: The NYPD released the footage a day after Mayor Mamdani urged Queens District Attorney Melinda Katz not to charge Chakraborty, with the mayor saying the suspect “needs mental health care, not criminal prosecution.”

item.title: NJ man accused of robbing Jets player at gunpoint in 2025
item.description: A New Jersey man has been charged in connection with a 2025 gunpoint robbery of an unnamed Jets player.

item.title: David Zayas replacing Timothy Busfield in ‘Law & Order: SVU’ guest role
item.description: "Dexter" star David Zayas is replacing Timothy Busfield in an upcoming "Law & Order: Special Victims Unit" guest role.

item.title: Queens boy, 2, in critical condition with head trauma, father arrested for assault
item.description: The victim suffered severe head trauma after his father attacked him inside the Manhattan View Hotel located on 21st St. near 38th Ave. in Astoria, according to law enforcement.

item.title: Knicks extend hot streak to 7 as Josh Hart, Mohamed Diawara get hurt in win vs. Wizards
item.description: Every Knicks starter played well below their season minutes average as Bridges led the way with 23 points.

item.title: Nets’ struggles follow them home in blowout loss to Lakers
item.description: The Nets looked flat, disconnected and late to everything early.

item.title: Asking Eric: Holiday hugs rubbed customer the wrong way
item.description: Dear Eric: For Christmas my husband and I travel a few hours and stay at a hotel near our son’s family. There is a man that works there readying the breakfast buffet.
